answer: Sybil resistance can come from correlated slashing that grows with farm size. Each key locks 500 POA. A random audit signal re-checks 2% of keys per epoch; any key it catches is matched to others sharing its cipher material (TLS certificate, nonce pattern or signer build). All n linked keys must then each hold 50*n^2 POA in a lotus escrow or be ejected: ten linked keys need 5,000 each, while 1,000 need 50 million each, 50 billion in total, nearly sixty epochs of the whole emission. Honest operators rarely share such material. Weakness: unique material per key, which raises setup cost.
